summary.en:
When New Helios was struck by a Level VII anomaly disaster, you appeared out of nowhere and assisted the Bureau of Anomaly Control in locating the "Hypervortex" Nexus, greatly accelerating its natural nullification process. At that moment, an unidentified anomaly with undetectable Wertheimer Index readings appeared—"Code Zero"—attempting to interfere with your actions. In the end, "Code Zero" was nullified along with the "Hypervortex." Afterward, you were temporarily detained at Ghroth Island prison for observation.

Seven weeks later, you were released to Hethereau, where you signed a contract with BAC Director Alphard, agreeing to participate in future "Code Zero" containment operations. She then assigned you to the Anomaly Hunter team "Eibon Antique Shop."

Before your departure, an unexpected incident occurred: CSU operative Mint reported that Anomaly R-3707 "Picture Frame" had suddenly breached containment. Once again, you demonstrated exceptional sensitivity to Anomaly Nexuses, helping Mint nullify the threat.

With everything wrapped up smoothly, you set out for Eibon. Are you ready for your new life to begin?
summary.id:
Saat New Helios dilanda bencana Anomaly Level VII, kamu muncul entah dari mana dan membantu Bureau of Anomaly Control menemukan Nexus "Hypervortex", sehingga proses Nullification alaminya jauh lebih cepat. Saat itu, muncul sebuah Anomaly tak dikenal yang Wertheimer Index-nya tak terdeteksi, yaitu "Code Zero", yang berusaha menghalangi tindakanmu. Pada akhirnya, "Code Zero" ikut ter-nullify bersama "Hypervortex". Setelah itu, kamu ditahan sementara di penjara Ghroth Island untuk diawasi.

Tujuh minggu kemudian, kamu dibebaskan ke Hethereau, tempat kamu menandatangani kontrak dengan Director BAC, Alphard, dan setuju ikut serta dalam operasi Containment "Code Zero" di masa mendatang. Ia lalu menempatkanmu di tim Anomaly Hunter "Eibon Antique Shop".

Sebelum kamu berangkat, terjadi insiden tak terduga: operatif CSU, Mint, melaporkan bahwa Anomaly R-3707 "Picture Frame" tiba-tiba lepas dari Containment. Sekali lagi, kamu menunjukkan kepekaan luar biasa terhadap Nexus Anomaly, membantu Mint me-nullify ancaman itu.

Setelah semuanya selesai dengan lancar, kamu berangkat menuju Eibon. Siapkah kamu memulai hidup barumu?

summary.en:
Accompanied by Mint, you arrived at Eibon Antique Shop on Hankaku Street in Bridge Crossings. After a small commotion caused by Anomaly T-1377 "Hospitable House," you finally met the antique shop's members properly and became part of Eibon.

That evening, you received your first commission as an Anomaly Hunter: Kodak, the owner of Film Orbit Studio in Bridge Crossings, reported that an Anomaly had appeared in his photo studio, turning the interior fixtures into photographs. Eibon accepted the commission and went to investigate.

After some investigation, you pinpointed the culprit: a film roll forgotten by time. In the darkroom, you found Anomaly R-5791 "Film - MANISH" and successfully contained it.

Kodak was very grateful and promised to take photos for you free of charge. As the newest member, you took a group photo with everyone. Soon after, these photos would be developed and displayed on your desks and bedsides, bearing witness to more stories yet to come.
summary.id:
Ditemani Mint, kamu tiba di Eibon Antique Shop di Hankaku Street, Bridge Crossings. Setelah sedikit keributan akibat Anomaly T-1377 "Hospitable House", kamu akhirnya berkenalan dengan anggota toko antik itu dan menjadi bagian dari Eibon.

Malam itu, kamu menerima komisi pertamamu sebagai Anomaly Hunter: Kodak, pemilik Film Orbit Studio di Bridge Crossings, melaporkan bahwa sebuah Anomaly muncul di studio fotonya dan mengubah perabot di dalamnya menjadi foto. Eibon menerima komisi itu dan pergi menyelidikinya.

Setelah menyelidiki, kamu menemukan pelakunya: sebuah gulungan film yang terlupakan oleh waktu. Di kamar gelap, kamu menemukan Anomaly R-5791 "Film - MANISH" dan berhasil meng-contain-nya.

Kodak sangat berterima kasih dan berjanji akan memotret kalian secara gratis. Sebagai anggota terbaru, kamu berfoto bersama semua orang. Tak lama lagi, foto-foto ini akan dicetak dan dipajang di meja dan samping ranjang kalian, menjadi saksi lebih banyak kisah yang akan datang.

summary.en:
Taygedo fell head over heels for an anomaly named Tako whom he met on Bagel. He bragged to Tako that he was the "boss of an anomaly hunter organization" with countless subordinates. Recently, with Tako about to leave Hethereau, they arranged to meet before her departure. At Taygedo's earnest request, you all decided to orchestrate a grand "love operation" for him.

After accompanying Taygedo to buy new clothes and the anomaly toy N-0132-4 "Imaginadough" as a gift, the date officially began. Everything proceeded according to Edgar's plan: you played the bodyguard to "Sir Taygedo," Adler played the butler, and Nanally and Sakiri… also provided plenty of assistance along the way. Despite frequent mishaps during the date, your stellar acting skills saved the day multiple times.

Finally, you arrived at the scenic destination, Azure Vista. Taygedo molded the prepared Imaginadough into a sculpture of himself and Tako holding hands as part of his performance, planning to confess his feelings. Just then, the Imaginadough sculpture suddenly went haywire for some unknown reason, wildly attacking everything around it. In the critical moment, you stepped in and restored the Imaginadough to its original state, resolving the crisis. Adler also promptly rescued Tako, ensuring her safety.

A few days later, Eibon received a postcard that Tako sent after moving to her new home. However, the letter wasn't addressed to Taygedo, but was a thank-you note to Adler for stepping up to help. Amid laughter and cheer, Taygedo's first love seemed to come to an end…
summary.id:
Taygedo jatuh cinta setengah mati pada Anomaly bernama Tako yang ia temui di Bagel. Ia menyombong kepada Tako bahwa dirinya "bos organisasi Anomaly Hunter" dengan anak buah yang tak terhitung. Belakangan, karena Tako akan segera meninggalkan Hethereau, mereka sepakat bertemu sebelum ia pergi. Atas permintaan Taygedo yang sungguh-sungguh, kalian semua memutuskan menyusun "operasi cinta" besar-besaran untuknya.

Setelah menemani Taygedo membeli baju baru dan mainan Anomaly N-0132-4 "Imaginadough" sebagai hadiah, kencan pun resmi dimulai. Semuanya berjalan sesuai rencana Edgar: kamu berperan sebagai pengawal "Tuan Taygedo", Adler sebagai butler, dan Nanally serta Sakiri… juga banyak membantu di sepanjang jalan. Meski kencannya sering diwarnai kekacauan, akting kalian yang luar biasa berkali-kali menyelamatkan keadaan.

Akhirnya, kalian tiba di tujuan yang indah, Azure Vista. Taygedo membentuk Imaginadough yang sudah disiapkan menjadi patung dirinya dan Tako yang bergandengan tangan sebagai bagian dari aksinya, berencana menyatakan perasaannya. Tepat saat itu, patung Imaginadough tiba-tiba mengamuk entah kenapa, menyerang segala sesuatu di sekitarnya. Di saat genting, kamu turun tangan dan mengembalikan Imaginadough ke wujud semula, menyelesaikan krisis itu. Adler juga sigap menyelamatkan Tako dan memastikan ia aman.

Beberapa hari kemudian, Eibon menerima kartu pos dari Tako setelah ia pindah ke rumah barunya. Namun, surat itu tidak ditujukan untuk Taygedo, melainkan ucapan terima kasih untuk Adler karena sudah turun tangan membantu. Di tengah tawa dan keceriaan, cinta pertama Taygedo sepertinya berakhir begitu saja…

summary.en:
Jenson, the owner of Sterry Express, suddenly paid a visit, hoping to invite you to participate in an auction hosted by Ebisu Auction House to help authenticate an anomaly lot. After some negotiation, Hotori proposed the additional condition of "going along herself" and struck a deal with Jenson.

To successfully infiltrate the auction, you used Esper Michael Pay's ability to duplicate and swap singer Settyn's invitation. On the day of the auction, Haniel and others disguised themselves as waitstaff to sneak into the venue, while you and Hotori entered officially as guests alongside Jiuyuan and Jenson.

When the target lot—the anomaly "The First Branch," said to possess precognitive abilities—was presented, a mysterious girl suddenly appeared. Using the freeze effect of the anomaly "Cheese," she forcibly acquired the lot for just 1 Fons and left immediately. After Hotori lifted the freeze effect on you all, you discovered that the girl had used the anomaly "Picky" to release several anomaly lots, triggering the security anomaly "Nantanì" and trapping you all in the auction house. Once the duplicated invitations expired, you would no longer be protected by Nantanì's rules. Therefore, you had to act quickly to re-contain the breached anomalies.

Afterward, Ebisu tried to shift the blame to Sterry and Eibon, but through Jiuyuan and Hotori's maneuvering, you managed to escape unscathed. Hotori avoided discussing your many questions but informed you that you could collaborate with Sterry's people in the future.

However, this incident seems to hide a deeper conspiracy—Ebisu Auction House's true intentions remain unclear, and the mysterious girl's motives for stealing the lot are still unknown… More mysteries have yet to surface.
summary.id:
Jenson, pemilik Sterry Express, tiba-tiba datang berkunjung dan ingin mengajakmu ikut lelang yang diadakan Ebisu Auction House untuk membantu memeriksa keaslian sebuah barang lelang berupa Anomaly. Setelah tawar-menawar, Hotori mengajukan syarat tambahan, yaitu "ikut sendiri", dan sepakat dengan Jenson.

Agar bisa menyusup ke lelang, kalian memakai kemampuan Esper Michael Pay untuk menggandakan dan menukar undangan milik penyanyi Settyn. Pada hari lelang, Haniel dan yang lain menyamar sebagai pelayan untuk menyelinap ke lokasi, sementara kamu dan Hotori masuk secara resmi sebagai tamu bersama Jiuyuan dan Jenson.

Saat barang incaran, Anomaly "The First Branch" yang konon punya kemampuan meramal, ditampilkan, seorang gadis misterius tiba-tiba muncul. Dengan efek pembeku dari Anomaly "Cheese", ia memaksa mendapatkan barang itu hanya seharga 1 Fons lalu langsung pergi. Setelah Hotori melepaskan efek beku dari kalian semua, kalian mendapati gadis itu memakai Anomaly "Picky" untuk melepaskan beberapa Anomaly yang dilelang, memicu Anomaly penjaga keamanan "Nantanì" dan mengurung kalian di dalam rumah lelang. Begitu undangan hasil gandaan kedaluwarsa, kalian tak lagi dilindungi aturan Nantanì. Karena itu, kalian harus bergerak cepat untuk meng-contain kembali Anomaly yang lepas.

Setelahnya, Ebisu berusaha melempar kesalahan ke Sterry dan Eibon, tapi berkat manuver Jiuyuan dan Hotori, kalian berhasil lolos tanpa masalah. Hotori menghindari berbagai pertanyaanmu, tapi memberitahumu bahwa ke depannya kamu bisa bekerja sama dengan orang-orang Sterry.

Namun, insiden ini tampaknya menyimpan konspirasi yang lebih dalam. Niat sebenarnya Ebisu Auction House masih belum jelas, dan motif gadis misterius itu mencuri barang lelang juga belum diketahui… Masih banyak misteri yang belum terungkap.

summary.en:
Eibon receives an anonymous package—a mysterious puppet. Simultaneously, there are rumors being spread on Bagel of citizens being turned into puppets by an Anomaly. You and Daffodill follow Hotori to the Bureau of Anomaly Control to assist with the investigation. Working alongside ETD-6, and using intel from Yggash Court, you discuss the case. After some investigating, you all conclude that this "puppet" was not initially a human. The clue that led to the discovery of the actual Anomaly lies in the black cards hidden in the Anomaly's pocket: each one has a name and is labeled with the number "0".

That same evening, a taxi driver named Renee comes to Eibon with a commission: every night at exactly nine o'clock, a cloaked, scythe-wielding Anomaly called the "Debt Collector" appears and attacks her—yet shockingly, she feels no pain at all. You, Nanally, and Daffodill take the commission and go with Renee to "Food First" to get more details from one of her regulars: Fuuka.

At nine o'clock that very night, the Debt Collector appears as planned. After a brief scuffle, it retreats, dropping a card that reads "Renee" and the number "-20088". You recognize it as identical to the cards from the earlier puppet case, and immediately contact Chaos. Everyone then agrees to head to The Witch's House, where Blackbird performs a divination for Renee. Strangely, the result of the divination is entirely blank, similar to the case years ago with Dolores, the head of the Constantine family. Blackbird concludes that the Debt Collector must be a Rule Anomaly, and that its nullification hinges on breaking the rule it follows.

The next day, someone drops a forged card into Renee's mailbox, with the address of the old Constantine estate printed on the front. Chaos guesses that Fuuka and the disguised courier who sent the puppet to Eibon must be operating under the same mastermind's orders. They invite Renee to walk to the family estate, as long as she's willing. When the group arrives, Renee stares at the cherry tree in the yard, recalling that she had once fallen from that same tree as a child. Suddenly, everyone is pulled into an Anomalous Realm.

The Anomalous Realm recreates the Constantine estate as it once was, years ago. You and Renee watch a farewell party, and piece together the family's history from the guests' conversations. Meanwhile, Nanally and Daffodill discover the Debt Collector hidden in the estate's study, along with a "register" that lists the family members' names with a number next to each. Every name has "0" listed next to it, except for Renee's, which is "-20088". Daffodill realizes that this must mean Renee has long overstayed her welcome amongst the living.

The eldest daughter, "Bella", appears before Renee and reveals the Constantine family's secret: Dolores was a unique Esper. To ease her loneliness, she used her own lifeforce as fuel to awaken a group of puppet children, letting them share an "eternity" granted by her contract with an Anomaly and stay by her side. All of these children were once puppets, and their lifespans began to count down from the moment Renee was born. They all hit zero over fifty years ago. Renee was the last to awaken and also Dolores's most favored child. Renee seemingly was able to escape death because her mother gifted her the Anomaly "Eternal Present", which was the source of her own endless life.

However, everything that was revealed of this "past" turned out to be an illusion, instrumented by Zankou, the actor performing "Bella". Zankou twisted the memories of the family, casting Renee as the sinner whose selfish betrayal brought misfortune upon the family. Through the mockery of children's voices and display of false illusions, Renee's sanity was slowly whittled down. It only took a few moments for Renee's mind to finally break, accepting the lie of her identity, and, on the verge of collapse, decide to give up the Eternal Present to atone for her "sins". At that crucial moment, you shout for her to stop—only for Zankou to snatch the Eternal Present. As you and Zankou go head to head, the nine o'clock bell tolls, and the Debt Collector returns. At that same moment, Chaos tears open space-time and steps through, with Nanally and Daffodill arriving in a spectacular, wall-breaking fashion. Just before retreating, Zankou turns to Daffodill and passes along "Mother's" regards. Afterwards, everyone at Eibon, together with Chaos, drive the Debt Collector back to where it came from.

After the battle, Chaos reveals Zankou's true identity: a core member of the criminal organization, "The Scarlet Letter". Actually, it seems that all characters in this play—the fake courier, Fuuka, and Bella from the party—were performed by her and her alone. Her goal was to force Renee to surrender the Anomaly "Eternal Present", while also using the entire incident as a way to announce the presence of The Scarlet Letter in Hethereau.

Back at Eibon, you and Daffodill discuss her past—she once was a member of The Scarlet Letter herself, and that her "Mother" was the group's leader, the very person she should have ended years ago.

Several days later, Renee returns to Eibon to thank everyone in person. Having lost "Eternal Present", she is finally released from immortality, and her missing memories and past have gradually been returning to her. She says that she has finally concluded that being alive is a blessing, precisely because life is fragile and fleeting. She bids Eibon farewell and sets off on a journey around the world, determined to experience all of life's ups and downs with the time she has left.
summary.id:
Eibon menerima paket tanpa nama berisi sebuah boneka misterius. Di saat yang sama, beredar rumor di Bagel tentang warga yang diubah menjadi boneka oleh sebuah Anomaly. Kamu dan Daffodill ikut Hotori ke Bureau of Anomaly Control untuk membantu penyelidikan. Bersama ETD-6, dan dengan informasi dari Yggash Court, kalian membahas kasus itu. Setelah menyelidiki, kalian menyimpulkan bahwa "boneka" ini awalnya bukan manusia. Petunjuk menuju Anomaly yang sebenarnya ada pada kartu-kartu hitam yang tersembunyi di saku Anomaly itu: setiap kartu bertuliskan sebuah nama dan angka "0".

Malam itu juga, seorang sopir taksi bernama Renee datang ke Eibon membawa komisi: setiap malam tepat pukul sembilan, Anomaly berjubah yang membawa sabit, disebut "Debt Collector", muncul dan menyerangnya, tapi anehnya ia sama sekali tidak merasa sakit. Kamu, Nanally, dan Daffodill menerima komisi itu dan pergi bersama Renee ke "Food First" untuk mencari keterangan lebih lanjut dari salah satu pelanggan tetapnya: Fuuka.

Tepat pukul sembilan malam itu, Debt Collector muncul seperti yang diduga. Setelah bentrokan singkat, ia mundur dan menjatuhkan sebuah kartu bertuliskan "Renee" dan angka "-20088". Kamu mengenalinya sebagai kartu yang sama dengan kasus boneka sebelumnya, dan langsung menghubungi Chaos. Semua orang lalu sepakat pergi ke The Witch's House, tempat Blackbird meramal untuk Renee. Anehnya, hasil ramalannya benar-benar kosong, mirip kasus Dolores, kepala keluarga Constantine, bertahun-tahun lalu. Blackbird menyimpulkan bahwa Debt Collector pasti Rule Anomaly, dan kunci Nullification-nya adalah mematahkan aturan yang ia ikuti.

Keesokan harinya, seseorang memasukkan kartu palsu ke kotak surat Renee, dengan alamat bekas kediaman keluarga Constantine tercetak di depannya. Chaos menduga Fuuka dan kurir menyamar yang mengirim boneka ke Eibon pasti bergerak atas perintah dalang yang sama. Mereka mengajak Renee berjalan ke kediaman keluarga itu, asalkan ia bersedia. Saat rombongan tiba, Renee menatap pohon sakura di halaman, teringat bahwa ia pernah jatuh dari pohon yang sama saat kecil. Tiba-tiba, semua orang tertarik masuk ke sebuah Anomalous Realm.

Anomalous Realm itu menghidupkan kembali kediaman Constantine seperti bertahun-tahun lalu. Kamu dan Renee menyaksikan sebuah pesta perpisahan, dan merangkai sejarah keluarga itu dari obrolan para tamu. Sementara itu, Nanally dan Daffodill menemukan Debt Collector yang bersembunyi di ruang kerja kediaman, beserta sebuah "buku catatan" berisi nama-nama anggota keluarga dengan angka di samping masing-masing. Setiap nama diberi angka "0", kecuali nama Renee yang bertuliskan "-20088". Daffodill sadar artinya Renee sudah terlalu lama tinggal di dunia orang hidup.

Putri sulung, "Bella", muncul di hadapan Renee dan membongkar rahasia keluarga Constantine: Dolores adalah Esper yang unik. Untuk mengusir kesepiannya, ia memakai daya hidupnya sendiri sebagai bahan bakar untuk membangkitkan sekelompok anak boneka, membiarkan mereka berbagi "keabadian" dari kontraknya dengan sebuah Anomaly agar tetap berada di sisinya. Semua anak ini dulunya boneka, dan umur mereka mulai menghitung mundur sejak Renee lahir. Mereka semua sudah mencapai nol lebih dari lima puluh tahun lalu. Renee adalah yang terakhir dibangkitkan sekaligus anak kesayangan Dolores. Renee tampaknya bisa lolos dari kematian karena ibunya menghadiahinya Anomaly "Eternal Present", sumber hidup abadinya sendiri.

Namun, semua "masa lalu" yang terungkap ini ternyata ilusi yang diatur Zankou, aktris yang memerankan "Bella". Zankou memutarbalikkan kenangan keluarga itu, menjadikan Renee pendosa yang pengkhianatan egoisnya membawa malapetaka bagi keluarga. Lewat ejekan suara anak-anak dan ilusi palsu, kewarasan Renee perlahan terkikis. Hanya butuh beberapa saat sampai pikiran Renee akhirnya hancur, menerima kebohongan tentang dirinya, dan di ambang keruntuhan, memutuskan menyerahkan Eternal Present untuk menebus "dosa-dosanya". Di saat genting itu, kamu berteriak agar ia berhenti, tapi Zankou justru merebut Eternal Present. Saat kamu berhadapan dengan Zankou, lonceng pukul sembilan berdentang, dan Debt Collector kembali. Pada saat yang sama, Chaos merobek ruang-waktu dan melangkah masuk, sementara Nanally dan Daffodill datang dengan cara spektakuler menembus dinding. Sesaat sebelum mundur, Zankou menoleh ke Daffodill dan menyampaikan salam dari "Ibu". Setelah itu, seluruh Eibon bersama Chaos mengusir Debt Collector kembali ke asalnya.

Setelah pertarungan, Chaos mengungkap identitas asli Zankou: anggota inti organisasi kriminal "The Scarlet Letter". Rupanya semua tokoh dalam sandiwara ini, mulai dari kurir palsu, Fuuka, sampai Bella di pesta, diperankan olehnya seorang diri. Tujuannya adalah memaksa Renee menyerahkan Anomaly "Eternal Present", sekaligus memakai seluruh insiden ini untuk mengumumkan kehadiran The Scarlet Letter di Hethereau.

Kembali di Eibon, kamu dan Daffodill membicarakan masa lalunya: ia dulu juga anggota The Scarlet Letter, dan "Ibu"-nya adalah pemimpin kelompok itu, orang yang seharusnya sudah ia habisi bertahun-tahun lalu.

Beberapa hari kemudian, Renee kembali ke Eibon untuk berterima kasih langsung kepada semua orang. Setelah kehilangan "Eternal Present", ia akhirnya terbebas dari keabadian, dan ingatan serta masa lalunya yang hilang perlahan kembali. Ia berkata akhirnya ia mengerti bahwa hidup adalah anugerah, justru karena hidup itu rapuh dan singkat. Ia berpamitan pada Eibon dan memulai perjalanan keliling dunia, bertekad merasakan semua suka dan duka hidup dengan sisa waktu yang ia punya.

summary.en:
After the events of Eternal Present, Daffodill was taken away by the Bureau of Anomaly Control for questioning and observation due to her deep past involvement with The Scarlet Letter. Many days passed without her return, and the atmosphere in Eibon was no longer the same. Nanally was especially worn down—not only because her master had been injured while saving her, but also because there had been no word from her since. As luck would have it, Taygedo won a family event package for Sunward Resort, and everyone suggested that you take Nanally there to help her clear her mind.

Sunward Resort was an Anomaly Charity House jointly established by the municipal government and the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Iroi, a volunteer at the resort, introduced you to many Anomalies, and Nanally gradually began to brighten up. Although she was too young to directly sponsor an Anomaly and bring it home, she received permission from the resort's investor, Ms. Inanna, to remotely sponsor a small bear-shaped Anomaly. Nanally and the little bear immediately hit it off. They signed the contract on the spot and agreed that she would return to the resort the next day to visit it.

At the pier on the way back, you unexpectedly encountered Daffodill, whom you had not seen in days. Nanally was overjoyed, but Daffodill treated her with coldness and hostility before following The Scarlet Letter member Poinsette through a portal. Nanally was devastated and believed she must have been the reason her master left. After a brief conflict with Sakiri, she shut herself in her room. It seemed Nanally was carrying pain she had never fully resolved. You knocked on her door, but received no response.

The next day, Nanally was nowhere to be found. Perhaps she had gone to the resort for her appointment, or perhaps she had left on her own to search for Daffodill. Everyone split up to look for her. You and Edgar asked Blackbird to divine Nanally's whereabouts and received three keywords: mist, the sound of tides, and a colossus. Blackbird also mentioned that disappearances had become frequent recently, with many people being drawn into a strange Anomalous Realm. Just then, Adler called with unsettling news: the resort had no sponsorship records under Nanally's name.

It turned out that the little bear who had signed the contract with Nanally was actually a dangerous Anomaly known as Teehee Bear, and the contract had been nothing more than a calculated deception. Following the clues, you tracked down Teehee Bear and exposed its true nature. Enraged, you and the others defeated it, but a strange, dense fog suddenly separated you from the group. You were drawn into an Anomalous Realm.

This was the place where Nanally had disappeared: the Corridor of Echoes. Guided by Thyme, you identified the pink tiger mascot in the parade as Nanally’s transformed form. You chased after her and entered the Dreamwalker's room. Meanwhile, Daffodill appeared to have changed sides completely and accepted a mission from The Scarlet Letter. In a garden, you met a girl who felt strangely familiar, as though the two of you had met before. With her help, you entered Nanally's Dream Room. Through a picture book, you passed through layer after layer of Nanally's dreams, learned about her past, and began to untie the knot in her heart.

You brought Nanally out of the room, only to be stopped by Thyme. She would only allow you to take away Nanally's copy—the Nanally who had cast aside evasion and obsession. Was the Ship of Theseus still the same ship once all of its parts had been replaced? You realized that Thyme, as the creator of the Corridor of Echoes, had also been running from her own past. She did not seem to understand that, all this time, she had been waiting for someone to break the rules and lead her forward. You fought Thyme to the very end. Moved by your will, the colossus representing her consciousness slowly began to change form. Just as you stopped, the colossus was suddenly nullified. Looking closer, you saw that the one who had arrived was Daffodill.

The Scarlet Letter tore through space and appeared. Their leader was revealed to be none other than Ms. Inanna, the resort's investor. She took the Anomaly that governed the rules of the past within the Corridor of Echoes: the Helm of Theseus. The mastermind behind everything finally revealed herself. Everything that had happened to Nanally was a conspiracy meticulously orchestrated by The Scarlet Letter from beginning to end. What was most baffling was that Daffodill seemed to have returned to The Scarlet Letter. With Thyme's consciousness nullified, the Dreamwalkers gradually disappeared. Through her own will and your efforts, Nanally managed to preserve only half of her soul before falling into a deep sleep. The Corridor of Echoes collapsed, and you escaped the space with Nanally and Thyme.

Back in Eibon, after Nanally and Thyme had been settled in, everyone wore a grave expression. What was the true reason behind Daffodill's betrayal? Hotori's attitude remained ambiguous, and you sensed that there had to be more to the story. The Scarlet Letter had seized another Anomaly—but what was the "game" they claimed was about to begin? After everything that had happened, Alphard contacted Hotori with new intelligence from the Bureau. The mystery deepened, and the operation against The Scarlet Letter finally reached a critical stage.
summary.id:
Setelah peristiwa Eternal Present, Daffodill dibawa Bureau of Anomaly Control untuk diinterogasi dan diawasi karena keterlibatannya yang dalam dengan The Scarlet Letter di masa lalu. Hari demi hari berlalu tanpa kepulangannya, dan suasana di Eibon tak lagi sama. Nanally yang paling terpukul, bukan hanya karena tuannya terluka saat menyelamatkannya, tapi juga karena sejak itu tak ada kabar sama sekali darinya. Kebetulan, Taygedo memenangkan paket acara keluarga ke Sunward Resort, dan semua orang menyarankan agar kamu mengajak Nanally ke sana supaya pikirannya lebih jernih.

Sunward Resort adalah Anomaly Charity House yang didirikan bersama oleh pemerintah kota dan Bureau of Anomaly Control. Iroi, relawan di resor itu, memperkenalkanmu pada banyak Anomaly, dan Nanally perlahan mulai ceria kembali. Meski masih terlalu muda untuk menjamin Anomaly secara langsung dan membawanya pulang, ia mendapat izin dari investor resor, Ms. Inanna, untuk menjamin seekor Anomaly berbentuk beruang kecil dari jauh. Nanally dan beruang kecil itu langsung akrab. Mereka menandatangani kontrak saat itu juga dan sepakat Nanally akan kembali ke resor keesokan harinya untuk menjenguknya.

Di dermaga dalam perjalanan pulang, kalian tak sengaja bertemu Daffodill yang sudah berhari-hari tidak terlihat. Nanally sangat gembira, tapi Daffodill memperlakukannya dengan dingin dan bermusuhan sebelum mengikuti Poinsette, anggota The Scarlet Letter, masuk ke sebuah portal. Nanally hancur dan yakin dirinyalah alasan tuannya pergi. Setelah sempat bertengkar dengan Sakiri, ia mengurung diri di kamar. Sepertinya Nanally menyimpan luka yang belum pernah benar-benar sembuh. Kamu mengetuk pintunya, tapi tak ada jawaban.

Keesokan harinya, Nanally menghilang. Mungkin ia pergi ke resor untuk menepati janjinya, atau mungkin ia pergi sendiri mencari Daffodill. Semua orang berpencar mencarinya. Kamu dan Edgar meminta Blackbird meramal keberadaan Nanally dan mendapat tiga kata kunci: kabut, suara pasang, dan raksasa. Blackbird juga menyebut bahwa belakangan ini banyak kasus orang hilang, dengan banyak orang tertarik masuk ke sebuah Anomalous Realm yang aneh. Saat itu juga, Adler menelepon membawa kabar yang meresahkan: resor itu tidak punya catatan penjaminan atas nama Nanally.

Ternyata beruang kecil yang menandatangani kontrak dengan Nanally sebenarnya adalah Anomaly berbahaya bernama Teehee Bear, dan kontrak itu tak lebih dari tipu daya yang sudah direncanakan. Mengikuti petunjuk, kalian melacak Teehee Bear dan membongkar wujud aslinya. Dengan geram, kamu dan yang lain mengalahkannya, tapi kabut tebal yang aneh tiba-tiba memisahkanmu dari kelompok. Kamu tertarik masuk ke sebuah Anomalous Realm.

Inilah tempat Nanally menghilang: Corridor of Echoes. Dengan bimbingan Thyme, kamu mengenali maskot harimau merah muda dalam parade sebagai wujud Nanally yang berubah. Kamu mengejarnya dan masuk ke kamar Dreamwalker. Sementara itu, Daffodill tampaknya benar-benar berpindah pihak dan menerima misi dari The Scarlet Letter. Di sebuah taman, kamu bertemu seorang gadis yang terasa akrab secara aneh, seolah kalian pernah bertemu sebelumnya. Dengan bantuannya, kamu masuk ke Dream Room milik Nanally. Lewat sebuah buku bergambar, kamu menembus lapis demi lapis mimpi Nanally, mengenal masa lalunya, dan mulai mengurai simpul di hatinya.

Kamu membawa Nanally keluar dari kamar itu, tapi dihadang Thyme. Ia hanya mengizinkanmu membawa salinan Nanally, yaitu Nanally yang sudah membuang sikap menghindar dan obsesinya. Apakah Kapal Theseus masih kapal yang sama setelah semua bagiannya diganti? Kamu sadar bahwa Thyme, sebagai pencipta Corridor of Echoes, juga sedang lari dari masa lalunya sendiri. Ia sepertinya tidak paham bahwa selama ini ia menunggu seseorang melanggar aturan dan menuntunnya maju. Kamu melawan Thyme sampai akhir. Tergerak oleh tekadmu, raksasa yang mewakili kesadarannya perlahan mulai berubah wujud. Tepat saat kamu berhenti, raksasa itu tiba-tiba di-nullify. Saat kamu melihat lebih dekat, yang datang ternyata Daffodill.

The Scarlet Letter muncul dengan merobek ruang. Pemimpin mereka ternyata tak lain adalah Ms. Inanna, investor resor itu. Ia mengambil Anomaly yang mengatur aturan masa lalu di dalam Corridor of Echoes: Helm of Theseus. Dalang di balik semuanya akhirnya menampakkan diri. Semua yang menimpa Nanally adalah konspirasi yang dirancang rapi oleh The Scarlet Letter dari awal sampai akhir. Yang paling membingungkan, Daffodill tampaknya sudah kembali ke The Scarlet Letter. Dengan kesadaran Thyme yang sudah di-nullify, para Dreamwalker perlahan menghilang. Berkat tekadnya sendiri dan usahamu, Nanally hanya berhasil mempertahankan separuh jiwanya sebelum jatuh tertidur lelap. Corridor of Echoes runtuh, dan kamu berhasil keluar bersama Nanally dan Thyme.

Kembali di Eibon, setelah Nanally dan Thyme ditempatkan dengan aman, semua orang berwajah muram. Apa alasan sebenarnya di balik pengkhianatan Daffodill? Sikap Hotori masih samar, dan kamu merasa pasti ada cerita lain di baliknya. The Scarlet Letter sudah merebut satu Anomaly lagi, tapi "permainan" apa yang mereka bilang akan segera dimulai? Setelah semua yang terjadi, Alphard menghubungi Hotori dengan informasi baru dari Bureau. Misterinya makin dalam, dan operasi melawan The Scarlet Letter akhirnya memasuki tahap genting.

summary.en:
Several days have passed since your escape from the Corridor. One evening, after visiting Nanally, you run into Hotori and Adler by the sea. During a heartfelt conversation, Hotori reveals that both The Scarlet Letter and the Bureau will make their move that night—and that you will be taking part as well.

Deep within The Scarlet Letter's stronghold, you successfully rendezvous with Chaos and Nitsa of ETD-6. A mysterious black coffin—the Anomaly known as Fog Coffin—remains at the scene, but Ms. T and her guests have already entered the Anomalous Realm. After discussing the situation with Alphard, you learn just how dangerous the Anomaly is. Even so, you decide to enter and investigate.

The Anomalous Realm is known as Fogden, and anyone who enters is automatically drawn into the Fogden Game.
Within Fogden, three stories unfold at once. Daffodill defeats several formidable guests before reuniting with Chaos. Guided by clues hidden in the rules, they venture into the fog, where Daffodill ultimately defeats Zankou and obtains the Helm of Theseus. Linko and Nitsa encounter a massive, serpent-like Oddity in a valley. Turning the tables on the creature, they defeat it and enter the fog, where they withstand the Encroachment of Eternal Present and rescue Adler. Meanwhile, Zero crosses a blood-soaked battlefield and enters the fog, encountering several future versions of Eibon. After seeing through Poinsette's deception, Zero finally discovers The First Branch.

Once everyone reaches the arena, the Fog Coffin Colossus announces the final rule: there can be only one victor, who may claim any one "item" belonging to a defeated contestant as their prize. Ms. T's true target is Hotori's Esper Ability. She confronts the group using powers granted by her contract with the Fog Coffin, but in doing so draws the attention of Code Zero. The Fog Coffin Colossus is effortlessly destroyed, and Fogden begins to collapse. Amid the chaos, Zankou betrays Ms. T, while Code Zero continues its assault on the others. Just as all hope seems lost, the Ship of Theseus tears through the sky and takes everyone aboard. With a single strike, Hotori stops Code Zero's pursuit, allowing the ship to pass safely through the portal and return to Hethereau.

You awaken in your dormitory bed to find everyone there—including Nanally, now fully recovered. Daffodill apologizes to everyone, prompting Eibon to burst into tears and apologies of their own. It is an ordinary day—and all the more precious for it.
summary.id:
Beberapa hari sudah berlalu sejak kamu lolos dari Corridor. Suatu sore, setelah menjenguk Nanally, kamu bertemu Hotori dan Adler di tepi laut. Dalam obrolan dari hati ke hati, Hotori mengungkapkan bahwa The Scarlet Letter dan Bureau sama-sama akan bergerak malam itu, dan kamu juga akan ikut serta.

Jauh di dalam markas The Scarlet Letter, kamu berhasil bertemu Chaos dan Nitsa dari ETD-6. Sebuah peti mati hitam misterius, Anomaly bernama Fog Coffin, masih ada di lokasi, tapi Ms. T dan para tamunya sudah masuk ke Anomalous Realm. Setelah membahas situasinya dengan Alphard, kamu tahu betapa berbahayanya Anomaly itu. Meski begitu, kamu memutuskan masuk untuk menyelidikinya.

Anomalous Realm itu bernama Fogden, dan siapa pun yang masuk otomatis ikut dalam Fogden Game.
Di dalam Fogden, tiga kisah berlangsung bersamaan. Daffodill mengalahkan beberapa tamu tangguh sebelum bertemu kembali dengan Chaos. Dipandu petunjuk yang tersembunyi dalam aturan, mereka masuk ke dalam kabut, dan di sana Daffodill akhirnya mengalahkan Zankou dan mendapatkan Helm of Theseus. Linko dan Nitsa bertemu Oddity raksasa mirip ular di sebuah lembah. Berbalik memojokkan makhluk itu, mereka mengalahkannya dan masuk ke kabut, menahan Encroachment dari Eternal Present, lalu menyelamatkan Adler. Sementara itu, Zero melintasi medan perang yang bersimbah darah dan masuk ke kabut, bertemu beberapa versi Eibon dari masa depan. Setelah membongkar tipu daya Poinsette, Zero akhirnya menemukan The First Branch.

Begitu semua orang tiba di arena, Fog Coffin Colossus mengumumkan aturan terakhir: hanya boleh ada satu pemenang, yang boleh mengambil satu "barang" apa pun milik peserta yang kalah sebagai hadiah. Incaran sebenarnya Ms. T adalah Esper Ability milik Hotori. Ia menghadapi kelompok itu dengan kekuatan dari kontraknya dengan Fog Coffin, tapi justru menarik perhatian Code Zero. Fog Coffin Colossus dihancurkan dengan mudah, dan Fogden mulai runtuh. Di tengah kekacauan, Zankou mengkhianati Ms. T, sementara Code Zero terus menyerang yang lain. Tepat saat semua harapan seakan sirna, Ship of Theseus merobek langit dan membawa semua orang naik. Dengan satu serangan, Hotori menghentikan kejaran Code Zero, sehingga kapal itu bisa melewati portal dengan aman dan kembali ke Hethereau.

Kamu terbangun di ranjang asrama dan mendapati semua orang ada di sana, termasuk Nanally yang sudah pulih sepenuhnya. Daffodill meminta maaf kepada semua orang, membuat seisi Eibon menangis dan ikut meminta maaf. Hari itu hanyalah hari biasa, dan justru karena itulah terasa begitu berharga.

summary.en:
You receive a special commission from Lavinia. Blackbird, owner of The Witch's House, has received a strange letter asking for help. The letter claims that there is a "commission only she can handle," sent by a mysterious person named Merula. Determined to find out what is going on, Blackbird decides to go there, and your commission turns out to be accompanying her and ensuring her safety.

Upon arriving at the island mentioned in the letter, you and Blackbird encounter a girl named Valmona. She tells you that a ritual to execute witches is being held near the island's fire trial tree. At the site of the burning, you discover that the trial is controlled by an anomaly known as the Inquisitor. After defeating it with the ETD squad who have already been investigating the island, you and Blackbird learn about the island's strange circumstances and decide to investigate further.

Just as your investigation gets underway, Valmona tells you that something unusual has happened near the tree. You and Blackbird rush there, only for Blackbird to begin acting strangely. She insists that she can hear someone calling for help, and walks toward the flames. As the fire engulfs her, you fear for her safety and follow her in.

When you regain consciousness, you somehow find yourselves inside another layer of Anomalous Realm. There, a girl who looks exactly like Valmona, but calls herself Annie, mistakes you for abandoned slaves and takes you back to the place where she lives—St. Arbor. To find the true culprit, you and Blackbird decide to stay in the town for the time being and continue your investigation.

Before long, strange things begin happening in town. A poisonous miasma appears in the forest outside the town, and ominous clouds loom over the skies of St. Arbor. Just as the townspeople grow increasingly worried, a human Inquisitor arrives in town. He claims that St. Arbor has been cursed by a witch, and that starting today, witch trials will be held until the witch's soul is found and burned.

The first two trials fail to find the witch's soul, but the scope of the search gradually expands to the townspeople themselves. Meanwhile, you also notice that Blackbird's memories are frequently becoming confused. She seems to keep mistaking herself for one of the townspeople. During the third trial, someone is burned to death, and Annie is likely to be the next victim. Unable to tolerate this any longer, you and Blackbird decide to put an end to this madness.

With your help, Annie is spared from being burned in the fourth trial, but the trials continue. Tormented by her conscience, she decides to step forward during the next trial and confess to being a witch. Just then, Blackbird offers to take Annie's place as the witch to be executed. She completely forgets who she is, while Annie finally reveals her true identity—Merula.

Everything Merula has done was intended to lure Blackbird back here and help her imprison the Inquisitor. What Merula does not know, however, is that the world has changed, and there isn't space for the anomaly Inquisitor to survive any more. After you explain the situation to her, she realizes what she truly needs to do: break the Fleshbound Cage that has imprisoned the Inquisitor for hundreds of years and completely nullify it.

Once everything is over, you return to Hethereau. The Oracle Stones on the island are purified, and Blackbird regains her lost memories. Back at The Witch's House, with Blackbird once again full of energy, Lavinia gives you another commission. This time, however, the commission is to take Blackbird around Hethereau and show her a good time…?
summary.id:
Kamu menerima komisi khusus dari Lavinia. Blackbird, pemilik The Witch's House, menerima surat aneh yang meminta pertolongan. Surat itu menyebut ada "komisi yang hanya bisa ditangani olehnya", dikirim oleh orang misterius bernama Merula. Bertekad mencari tahu apa yang terjadi, Blackbird memutuskan pergi ke sana, dan komisimu ternyata adalah menemaninya serta memastikan ia aman.

Setibanya di pulau yang disebut dalam surat, kamu dan Blackbird bertemu seorang gadis bernama Valmona. Ia bercerita bahwa ritual eksekusi penyihir sedang diadakan di dekat pohon pengadilan api di pulau itu. Di lokasi pembakaran, kalian mendapati bahwa pengadilan itu dikendalikan Anomaly bernama Inquisitor. Setelah mengalahkannya bersama regu ETD yang sudah lebih dulu menyelidiki pulau itu, kamu dan Blackbird mengetahui keadaan aneh pulau tersebut dan memutuskan menyelidiki lebih jauh.

Tepat saat penyelidikan dimulai, Valmona memberitahu bahwa sesuatu yang tidak biasa terjadi di dekat pohon itu. Kamu dan Blackbird bergegas ke sana, tapi Blackbird mulai bertingkah aneh. Ia bersikeras mendengar seseorang minta tolong, lalu berjalan ke arah api. Saat api melahapnya, kamu khawatir akan keselamatannya dan ikut masuk.

Saat sadar kembali, entah bagaimana kalian berada di lapisan Anomalous Realm yang lain. Di sana, seorang gadis yang mirip sekali dengan Valmona, tapi menyebut dirinya Annie, mengira kalian budak yang ditelantarkan dan membawa kalian ke tempat tinggalnya, St. Arbor. Untuk menemukan pelaku sebenarnya, kamu dan Blackbird memutuskan tinggal di kota itu untuk sementara dan melanjutkan penyelidikan.

Tak lama kemudian, hal-hal aneh mulai terjadi di kota. Kabut beracun muncul di hutan luar kota, dan awan yang mencekam menggantung di langit St. Arbor. Saat warga kota makin cemas, seorang Inquisitor manusia tiba di kota. Ia mengklaim St. Arbor dikutuk seorang penyihir, dan mulai hari itu, pengadilan penyihir akan diadakan sampai jiwa sang penyihir ditemukan dan dibakar.

Dua pengadilan pertama gagal menemukan jiwa penyihir, tapi cakupan pencarian perlahan meluas ke warga kota sendiri. Sementara itu, kamu juga menyadari ingatan Blackbird sering kacau. Ia seperti terus mengira dirinya salah satu warga kota. Dalam pengadilan ketiga, seseorang dibakar sampai mati, dan Annie kemungkinan besar akan jadi korban berikutnya. Tak sanggup lagi membiarkannya, kamu dan Blackbird memutuskan mengakhiri kegilaan ini.

Berkat bantuanmu, Annie lolos dari pembakaran di pengadilan keempat, tapi pengadilan terus berlanjut. Tersiksa oleh hati nuraninya, ia memutuskan maju di pengadilan berikutnya dan mengaku sebagai penyihir. Saat itu juga, Blackbird menawarkan diri menggantikan Annie sebagai penyihir yang akan dieksekusi. Ia benar-benar lupa siapa dirinya, sementara Annie akhirnya mengungkap identitas aslinya: Merula.

Semua yang dilakukan Merula bertujuan memancing Blackbird kembali ke sini dan membantunya memenjarakan Inquisitor. Namun, yang tidak Merula ketahui adalah dunia sudah berubah, dan tak ada lagi tempat bagi Anomaly Inquisitor untuk bertahan. Setelah kamu menjelaskan keadaannya, ia sadar apa yang sebenarnya harus ia lakukan: menghancurkan Fleshbound Cage yang telah memenjarakan Inquisitor selama ratusan tahun dan me-nullify-nya sepenuhnya.

Setelah semuanya usai, kalian kembali ke Hethereau. Oracle Stone di pulau itu dimurnikan, dan Blackbird mendapatkan kembali ingatannya yang hilang. Kembali di The Witch's House, dengan Blackbird yang kembali bersemangat, Lavinia memberimu komisi lain. Tapi kali ini, komisinya adalah mengajak Blackbird berkeliling Hethereau dan membuatnya bersenang-senang…?

title.en: Meet Me in the Data Stream
title.id: Meet Me in the Data Stream

summary.en:
Edgar told you an urban legend about the "Invalid Number". Four years ago, many people dreamed that an old friend they'd lost touch with gave them an unreachable number. Every dream featured the same number, digit for digit. Curious, you dialed it too, but the call didn't go through. After falling asleep, you dreamed of an unfamiliar room. A phone on the floor rang, and when you answered it, Nitsa from ETD was on the line.
When you woke, you went to the Bureau to ask Nitsa about the call. She told you that ETD-6's captain and lieutenant had apparently left nearly two months earlier to handle a confidential case and had since gone missing. The only lead was the mysterious space you'd entered in your dream, where you'd found the lieutenant's phone. Worried about her friends' safety, you and Nitsa dialed the "Invalid Number" together—but only you entered the Anomalous Realm again.
There, you met Exe, ETD-6's captain. He explained that the high-level Meme Anomaly "Imaginary Old Friend" had evolved from the "Invalid Number" and was born from humanity's collective imagining of an ideal friend. It draws on the memories people share with old friends they hope to reconnect with, then creates "friends" tailored to their needs. These creations return to their users, gradually eroding and overwriting the place of their real friends in their memories.
Exe was hacking into Archive Units one by one to examine the fabricated "friends" and search for the Anomaly's core. You split up to explore and try to meet up with the lieutenant. In one Archive Unit, you found the lieutenant from Nitsa's photo: "Roxanne." Exe suddenly appeared and shot and killed her. Your consciousness then faded as if your connection had been severed.
When you woke again, you found yourself in a sunny meadow beneath a bright blue sky. There you met a peculiar girl who said her default name was "Elyms." By reverse-engineering the space, you realized it was a special Archive Unit belonging to Exe. Elyms was a counterpart of the "Imaginary Old Friend" and ETD-6's lieutenant. She explained her Anomaly abilities and how she had joined the Bureau as a person in her own right. Then you learned the shocking truth: this operation was Exe's reckless, single-minded plan to erase his own partner, Elyms.
Elyms told you a hazy, fairy-tale-like story whose truth could never be objectively verified: the story of "X," a brilliant but ill-tempered boy, and "Y," a mischievous, lonely computer spirit… from their innocent, carefree beginnings to their cruel, twisted end.
Exe refused to accept the "Invalid Number." He would rather keep reopening his own wounds and endure the pain as if it were new each day than lose the only proof that the "real Y" had existed: every memory in his mind, every vivid trace of his most precious treasure. He had cast himself as an antivirus program whose goal was to erase the "Imaginary Old Friend." After hearing all this, you began to understand why Elyms had brought you there. Torn by conflicting feelings, you decided to play a game, become Elyms's friend, and return to the Anomalous Realm.
At the end of that long journey, Exe compiled data on 316,650 friend-images, transferred it to a single storage medium, and released it all at once. With his complete understanding of the "Imaginary Old Friend," he gave the formless Meme Anomaly a "true form"—by hacking into his own brain and blasting it out. He trusted without a doubt that the Anomalous Realm's restoration mechanism would bring him back after death, just as the Anomaly believed that the version of itself known to this human was its own "true form."
…And so, he carried out this extraordinary crime.
You reached Exe just as he managed to erase the "Imaginary Old Friend," only to find him sinking into an even deeper void. You couldn't sway this clear-headed, frighteningly single-minded man who no longer cared about anything—unless there was still something in the world he had to care about, some "target." To fulfill Nitsa's request, preserve the new connections the "Imaginary Old Friend" had created, and stop Exe from destroying himself, you fought him to buy Elyms time. Though he should have been nearing his physical and mental limits, Exe showed no sign of stopping. He wrecked the arena, trapping you and leaving you behind.
Elyms raced through the shattered Anomalous Realm, making call after call to restore the genuine connections that had been severed between people and their "false friends," rebuilding her own code as she went. After sending you back to safety, she chose to face the pursuing Exe as the one "friend who would stand against him"—
"We're fighting with the very meaning of our existence on the line… and yet, doesn't it remind you of long ago, when we could forget the world and play together like the best of friends, carefree and thinking it would last forever?"
Days later, a return call brought news: both ETD-6's captain and lieutenant had made it back to Hethereau alive. After all that, it seemed Elyms had just barely won this round.
The latest showdown between "Boy X" and "Imaginary Y" was over for now, and its record was sealed in the "Imaginary Old Friend's" secret hideout. They had to face the future without answers and grow up even if they hated to leave. The two "ever-unchanging, elf-like children" couldn't stay in their vacation dreamland forever. For now, at least, it was time to switch back to "adult" mode… Pull yourself together, take responsibility, and get back to work.
—Until "tomorrow," when they meet again as enemies.
summary.id:
Edgar menceritakan sebuah legenda urban tentang "Invalid Number". Empat tahun lalu, banyak orang bermimpi seorang teman lama yang sudah lama hilang kontak memberi mereka nomor yang tak bisa dihubungi. Di setiap mimpi, nomornya sama persis, digit demi digit. Penasaran, kamu juga menelepon nomor itu, tapi panggilannya tidak tersambung. Setelah tertidur, kamu bermimpi berada di sebuah kamar yang asing. Sebuah telepon di lantai berdering, dan saat kamu mengangkatnya, Nitsa dari ETD ada di ujung sana.
Saat bangun, kamu pergi ke Bureau untuk menanyakan panggilan itu kepada Nitsa. Ia bercerita bahwa kapten dan letnan ETD-6 rupanya pergi hampir dua bulan lalu untuk menangani kasus rahasia dan sejak itu menghilang. Satu-satunya petunjuk adalah ruang misterius yang kamu masuki dalam mimpi, tempat kamu menemukan ponsel sang letnan. Khawatir akan keselamatan teman-temannya, kamu dan Nitsa menelepon "Invalid Number" bersama-sama, tapi hanya kamu yang kembali masuk ke Anomalous Realm.
Di sana, kamu bertemu Exe, kapten ETD-6. Ia menjelaskan bahwa Meme Anomaly tingkat tinggi "Imaginary Old Friend" berevolusi dari "Invalid Number" dan lahir dari bayangan kolektif umat manusia tentang teman yang ideal. Ia memanfaatkan kenangan orang-orang bersama teman lama yang ingin mereka temui lagi, lalu menciptakan "teman" yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan mereka. Ciptaan ini kembali kepada penggunanya, perlahan mengikis dan menimpa tempat teman asli mereka dalam ingatan.
Exe membobol Archive Unit satu per satu untuk memeriksa "teman" buatan itu dan mencari inti Anomaly. Kalian berpencar untuk menjelajah dan mencoba bertemu sang letnan. Di salah satu Archive Unit, kamu menemukan letnan dari foto Nitsa: "Roxanne". Exe tiba-tiba muncul lalu menembaknya sampai mati. Kesadaranmu kemudian memudar seolah koneksimu terputus.
Saat bangun lagi, kamu berada di padang rumput yang cerah di bawah langit biru. Di sana, kamu bertemu seorang gadis unik yang mengatakan nama bawaannya adalah "Elyms". Dengan merekayasa balik ruang itu, kamu sadar bahwa itu adalah Archive Unit khusus milik Exe. Elyms adalah padanan "Imaginary Old Friend" sekaligus letnan ETD-6. Ia menjelaskan kemampuan Anomaly-nya dan bagaimana ia bergabung dengan Bureau sebagai pribadi yang utuh. Lalu kamu mengetahui kebenaran yang mengejutkan: operasi ini adalah rencana nekat Exe yang keras kepala untuk menghapus partnernya sendiri, Elyms.
Elyms menceritakan kisah samar bak dongeng yang kebenarannya tak akan pernah bisa dibuktikan secara objektif: kisah "X", bocah jenius berwatak buruk, dan "Y", roh komputer jahil yang kesepian… dari awal mereka yang polos dan riang hingga akhir mereka yang kejam dan menyimpang.
Exe menolak menerima "Invalid Number". Ia lebih memilih terus membuka lukanya sendiri dan menanggung sakitnya setiap hari seolah baru, daripada kehilangan satu-satunya bukti bahwa "Y yang asli" pernah ada: setiap kenangan di benaknya, setiap jejak nyata harta paling berharganya. Ia menjadikan dirinya program antivirus yang bertujuan menghapus "Imaginary Old Friend". Setelah mendengar semua ini, kamu mulai mengerti kenapa Elyms membawamu ke sana. Terombang-ambing oleh perasaan yang saling bertentangan, kamu memutuskan untuk ikut bermain, menjadi teman Elyms, dan kembali ke Anomalous Realm.
Di akhir perjalanan panjang itu, Exe mengumpulkan data 316.650 citra teman, memindahkannya ke satu media penyimpanan, lalu melepaskan semuanya sekaligus. Dengan pemahamannya yang utuh tentang "Imaginary Old Friend", ia memberi Meme Anomaly tanpa wujud itu sebuah "wujud asli", dengan membobol otaknya sendiri dan meledakkannya keluar. Ia yakin tanpa ragu bahwa mekanisme pemulihan Anomalous Realm akan menghidupkannya kembali setelah mati, sama seperti Anomaly itu yakin bahwa versi dirinya yang dikenal manusia ini adalah "wujud asli"-nya.
…Dan begitulah, ia melakukan kejahatan yang luar biasa ini.
Kamu sampai di tempat Exe tepat saat ia berhasil menghapus "Imaginary Old Friend", tapi justru mendapatinya tenggelam ke kehampaan yang lebih dalam. Kamu tak bisa menggoyahkan pria berkepala dingin dan keras kepala yang menakutkan ini, yang tak lagi peduli pada apa pun, kecuali jika masih ada sesuatu di dunia yang harus ia pedulikan, sebuah "target". Demi memenuhi permintaan Nitsa, menjaga koneksi baru yang diciptakan "Imaginary Old Friend", dan menghentikan Exe menghancurkan dirinya sendiri, kamu melawannya untuk mengulur waktu bagi Elyms. Meski seharusnya sudah mendekati batas fisik dan mentalnya, Exe sama sekali tak menunjukkan tanda akan berhenti. Ia menghancurkan arena, menjebakmu, dan meninggalkanmu.
Elyms berlari menembus Anomalous Realm yang hancur, menelepon berkali-kali untuk memulihkan koneksi tulus yang sempat terputus antara orang-orang dan "teman palsu" mereka, sambil membangun ulang kodenya sendiri. Setelah mengirimmu kembali ke tempat aman, ia memilih menghadapi Exe yang mengejarnya sebagai satu-satunya "teman yang akan melawannya"—
"Kita bertarung dengan taruhan makna keberadaan kita… tapi bukankah ini mengingatkanmu pada masa lalu, saat kita bisa melupakan dunia dan bermain bersama layaknya sahabat terbaik, tanpa beban, dan mengira semuanya akan bertahan selamanya?"
Beberapa hari kemudian, sebuah panggilan balik membawa kabar: kapten dan letnan ETD-6 sama-sama berhasil kembali ke Hethereau dalam keadaan hidup. Setelah semua itu, tampaknya Elyms baru saja memenangkan ronde ini dengan selisih tipis.
Pertarungan terbaru antara "Bocah X" dan "Y Khayalan" sudah usai untuk sementara, dan catatannya disegel di tempat persembunyian rahasia "Imaginary Old Friend". Mereka harus menghadapi masa depan tanpa jawaban dan tumbuh dewasa meski enggan berpisah. Dua "anak bak peri yang tak pernah berubah" itu tak bisa tinggal di negeri impian liburan mereka selamanya. Setidaknya untuk sekarang, saatnya kembali ke mode "dewasa"… Kuatkan diri, ambil tanggung jawab, dan kembali bekerja.
—Sampai "besok", saat mereka bertemu lagi sebagai musuh.

summary.en:
Eibon received a commission from Bianca, PR manager of Landric, to search for the genius Perfumer Toshi who had suddenly disappeared. While searching for clues in his apartment, a strange bird and dog appeared and made off with Toshi's Censer.

Following intel from Jiuyuan of Sterry Express, you tracked down "Cake Sweeper," the author of manga Tales of Nil, and met a young man named Boomboom outside her home. His dog Dandelion, who had been missing for a long time, had appeared in the manga. Cake Sweeper told you about her encounter with Pawn Moonlight, claiming that "any wish could be granted there for the right Price," and revealed that the dog and bird that inspired her work were both in the pawnshop.

As fate would have it, chef Kenneth commissioned you to retrieve his sense of taste, which was taken by the pawnshop owner without reason, and pointed you to Green Wall Slope. You headed there immediately. Inside the pawnshop, you met the owners—twin brothers Otro and Mismo. It turned out Kenneth had kidnapped Toshi—who had accompanied him to the pawnshop before—fearing exposure after regretting his Pawn Contract. Mismo had rescued Toshi.

In the end, the cunning Kenneth's scheme failed, Boomboom reunited with his beloved dog—who was actually Anomaly U-5228 "Morphix"—and Otro and Mismo left Hethereau, taking their unsolved mysteries with them. On Green Wall Slope, Pawn Moonlight vanished without a trace.
summary.id:
Eibon menerima komisi dari Bianca, manajer PR Landric, untuk mencari Toshi, perfumer jenius yang tiba-tiba menghilang. Saat mencari petunjuk di apartemennya, seekor burung dan anjing aneh muncul lalu membawa kabur Censer milik Toshi.

Mengikuti informasi dari Jiuyuan dari Sterry Express, kamu melacak "Cake Sweeper", pengarang manga Tales of Nil, dan bertemu seorang pemuda bernama Boomboom di depan rumahnya. Anjingnya, Dandelion, yang sudah lama hilang, ternyata muncul di manga itu. Cake Sweeper bercerita tentang pertemuannya dengan Pawn Moonlight, mengatakan bahwa "keinginan apa pun bisa dikabulkan di sana dengan Harga yang pantas", dan mengungkapkan bahwa anjing dan burung yang menginspirasi karyanya sama-sama ada di rumah gadai itu.

Kebetulan, koki Kenneth memintamu mengambil kembali indra perasanya yang diambil pemilik rumah gadai tanpa alasan, dan menunjukkan jalan ke Green Wall Slope. Kamu langsung ke sana. Di dalam rumah gadai, kamu bertemu pemiliknya, saudara kembar Otro dan Mismo. Ternyata Kenneth-lah yang menculik Toshi, yang sebelumnya pernah menemaninya ke rumah gadai itu, karena takut ketahuan setelah menyesali Pawn Contract-nya. Mismo telah menyelamatkan Toshi.

Pada akhirnya, rencana licik Kenneth gagal, Boomboom kembali bersama anjing kesayangannya, yang ternyata adalah Anomaly U-5228 "Morphix", dan Otro serta Mismo meninggalkan Hethereau dengan membawa misteri mereka yang belum terpecahkan. Di Green Wall Slope, Pawn Moonlight lenyap tanpa jejak.

summary.en:
You accept Mint's invitation to play an anomaly board game called "999 Nights" with three of the members of CSU-2. You enter the game to challenge the Crimson Dragon as a Swordsman along with Mage Iroi, Barbarian Mint, and Villager Shinku.

Your epic journey begins at the Fuzzy Village. You listen to the stories of the past from the elder: An evil Crimson Dragon once ruled the land. A brave team led by a heroine defeated him, yet somehow, the Crimson Dragon came back. The Fuzzies suffer again, and to defeat the dragon and restore peace, you decide to collect the armor fragments left by the heroine.

After overcoming trials and tribulations, you finally retrieve the last armor fragment from the Crimson Dragon's castle. Only then, do you learn the truth behind the legend: the heroine lost her mind after wearing the armor and turned against her team. Shinku's reaction makes you realize this might be more than just a story.

With the other three encouraging her, Shinku gradually comes to trust her companions and her own powers. She wears the heroine's armor and successfully defeats the evil dragon. And so, true peace is restored to the Warren Continent, with Fuzzies singing songs of the heroine's deeds to honor the "Dragonfruit Knight" and her three precious companions!
summary.id:
Kamu menerima ajakan Mint untuk memainkan permainan papan Anomaly bernama "999 Nights" bersama tiga anggota CSU-2. Kamu masuk ke dalam permainan untuk menantang Crimson Dragon sebagai Swordsman, bersama Mage Iroi, Barbarian Mint, dan Villager Shinku.

Perjalanan epikmu dimulai di Fuzzy Village. Kamu mendengarkan kisah masa lalu dari tetua desa: dulu seekor Crimson Dragon jahat pernah menguasai negeri ini. Sebuah tim pemberani yang dipimpin seorang pahlawan wanita berhasil mengalahkannya, tapi entah bagaimana Crimson Dragon itu kembali. Para Fuzzy kembali menderita, dan demi mengalahkan sang naga dan memulihkan kedamaian, kamu memutuskan mengumpulkan pecahan zirah yang ditinggalkan sang pahlawan.

Setelah melewati berbagai rintangan, kamu akhirnya mendapatkan pecahan zirah terakhir dari kastel Crimson Dragon. Baru saat itulah kamu tahu kebenaran di balik legenda itu: sang pahlawan kehilangan akal sehat setelah memakai zirah itu dan berbalik melawan timnya. Reaksi Shinku membuatmu sadar bahwa ini mungkin bukan sekadar cerita.

Dengan dorongan dari tiga temannya, Shinku perlahan belajar memercayai rekan-rekannya dan kekuatannya sendiri. Ia memakai zirah sang pahlawan dan berhasil mengalahkan naga jahat itu. Kedamaian sejati pun kembali ke Warren Continent, dengan para Fuzzy menyanyikan lagu tentang kisah sang pahlawan untuk menghormati "Dragonfruit Knight" dan tiga rekannya yang berharga!

summary.en:
Taygedo took on a bounty commission: nullify the "Tomato Devil"—an anomaly that specifically destroys tomato jelly vending machines. You accompanied Taygedo to investigate, but learned from other Anomaly Hunters tracking the case that the Tomato Devil's true identity wasn't an anomaly at all, but rather Lacrimosa, a member of the Enforcement Tactical Division Squad Four under the Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Through Mint's introduction, you officially met Lacrimosa and learned the whole story: due to her lack of common sense, Lacrimosa had accidentally destroyed a vending machine. Although she compensated for the damage and apologized afterward, photos taken by passersby spread widely online, attracting a flood of malicious rumors. These false statements about Lacrimosa gradually fermented and eventually evolved into a Meme Anomaly—the Tomato Devil. This anomaly, born from rumors about Lacrimosa, resembled her in appearance, dragging Lacrimosa even deeper into public opinion.

To clear up the rumors, you and Taygedo planned a live stream, broadcasting footage of the real Lacrimosa battling the Tomato Devil anomaly, letting the truth speak for itself. As public opinion gradually shifted, the Meme Anomaly born from rumors was significantly weakened and finally dissolved into tomato jelly and disappeared.

Although new trending topics quickly diverted public attention, it was precisely because you and Taygedo took action that you were able to clear up the public's misunderstanding of Lacrimosa, restore her reputation, and truly protect her. Even if the truth gets buried temporarily, persisting in speaking out is never in vain.
summary.id:
Taygedo menerima komisi sayembara: me-nullify "Tomato Devil", Anomaly yang khusus merusak mesin penjual jeli tomat. Kamu menemani Taygedo menyelidikinya, tapi dari Anomaly Hunter lain yang juga melacak kasus ini, kamu tahu bahwa identitas asli Tomato Devil sama sekali bukan Anomaly, melainkan Lacrimosa, anggota Enforcement Tactical Division Squad Four di bawah Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Lewat perkenalan dari Mint, kamu resmi bertemu Lacrimosa dan mengetahui cerita lengkapnya: karena kurang paham hal-hal umum, Lacrimosa tak sengaja merusak sebuah mesin penjual otomatis. Meski ia sudah mengganti kerugian dan meminta maaf, foto-foto yang diambil orang yang lewat menyebar luas di internet dan memicu banjir rumor jahat. Pernyataan palsu tentang Lacrimosa ini perlahan berkembang dan akhirnya berevolusi menjadi Meme Anomaly, yaitu Tomato Devil. Anomaly yang lahir dari rumor tentang Lacrimosa ini berpenampilan mirip dengannya, sehingga menyeret Lacrimosa makin dalam ke pusaran opini publik.

Untuk meluruskan rumor itu, kamu dan Taygedo merencanakan siaran langsung yang menayangkan Lacrimosa asli melawan Anomaly Tomato Devil, membiarkan kebenaran berbicara sendiri. Seiring opini publik perlahan berubah, Meme Anomaly yang lahir dari rumor itu melemah drastis dan akhirnya larut menjadi jeli tomat lalu menghilang.

Meski topik trending baru cepat mengalihkan perhatian publik, justru karena kamu dan Taygedo bertindaklah kesalahpahaman publik terhadap Lacrimosa bisa diluruskan, reputasinya dipulihkan, dan ia benar-benar terlindungi. Meski kebenaran sempat terkubur, terus bersuara tak pernah sia-sia.

summary.en:
Haniel invited you to come watch a performance at Livehouse "StarSign," where you met her friends Akane Rin and owner Kiyosawa. Infected by the atmosphere of live music, an excited Haniel decided to pick up the guitar she had once taught herself, while Kiyosawa generously provided a practice space.

Soon after, Nanally proposed forming a band and enthusiastically invited you and Haniel to join. Moved by your enthusiasm, Akane Rin began supporting you all as a mentor. With Akane Rin's help, the band started serious rehearsals.

After some time and effort, your band completed its warm-up debut at StarSign. Despite some mistakes due to nerves during the performance, Akane Rin stepped in to save the day, and the show was completed successfully to audience applause. Encouraged by this, you decided to take on an even greater challenge: the legendary music festival, the Location Anomaly "Night of Moondog."

To achieve a high score at the Night of Moondog and find a way to resonate with anomalies, Haniel and Nanally decided to risk challenging the graffiti anomaly "Bopp" with music. When you discovered the two had gone missing, you and Akane Rin immediately rushed to find them. Akane Rin, in a rare display of anger, scolded them for their reckless behavior.

Finally, Akane Rin decided to officially join the band, and the group, now named "The Whoots!!!!" successfully took the stage at the Night of Moondog. Though they didn't win first place, they achieved a score of 60 points on their debut performance. After the show, Akane Rin reunited with Aurelia, a former bandmate from "Lines," and a long-held grudge was finally resolved. Even when starlight scatters across the heavens, it never truly disappears, and the music that resonates on stage will continue forever…
summary.id:
Haniel mengajakmu menonton pertunjukan di Livehouse "StarSign", tempat kamu bertemu temannya, Akane Rin, dan pemiliknya, Kiyosawa. Terbawa suasana musik live, Haniel yang bersemangat memutuskan untuk kembali memainkan gitar yang dulu ia pelajari sendiri, sementara Kiyosawa dengan murah hati menyediakan tempat latihan.

Tak lama kemudian, Nanally mengusulkan membentuk band dan dengan antusias mengajakmu dan Haniel bergabung. Tersentuh oleh semangat kalian, Akane Rin mulai mendukung kalian sebagai mentor. Dengan bantuan Akane Rin, band itu mulai berlatih dengan serius.

Setelah waktu dan usaha yang tidak sedikit, band kalian menyelesaikan debut pemanasan di StarSign. Meski sempat melakukan kesalahan karena gugup, Akane Rin turun tangan menyelamatkan keadaan, dan pertunjukan selesai dengan sukses diiringi tepuk tangan penonton. Terdorong oleh itu, kalian memutuskan mengambil tantangan yang lebih besar: festival musik legendaris, Location Anomaly "Night of Moondog".

Demi meraih skor tinggi di Night of Moondog dan menemukan cara untuk beresonansi dengan Anomaly, Haniel dan Nanally nekat menantang Anomaly grafiti "Bopp" dengan musik. Saat kamu sadar keduanya menghilang, kamu dan Akane Rin langsung bergegas mencari mereka. Akane Rin, yang jarang sekali marah, memarahi mereka karena bertindak gegabah.

Akhirnya, Akane Rin memutuskan bergabung secara resmi dengan band, dan grup yang kini bernama "The Whoots!!!!" berhasil naik panggung di Night of Moondog. Meski tidak menjadi juara pertama, mereka meraih skor 60 poin di penampilan debutnya. Setelah pertunjukan, Akane Rin bertemu kembali dengan Aurelia, mantan rekan satu bandnya di "Lines", dan dendam lama akhirnya terselesaikan. Bahkan saat cahaya bintang berserakan di langit, ia tak pernah benar-benar hilang, dan musik yang bergema di panggung akan terus berlanjut selamanya…

summary.en:
With Clement Academy's centennial celebration approaching, Akane Rin finally agreed—after Haniel and Nanally's multiple pleas—to return to her alma mater as a special guest alumna, with everyone else tagging along to celebrate. Before that, though, you first had to get a proper school uniform. While on a shopping trip, Akane Rin also brought along her old classmate, Aurelia, and introduced her to the other members of "THE WHOOTS!!!!".

On the day of the celebration, the group arrived on campus and met Suzuha, who had once been Akane Rin's bandmate in the band "Lines," as well as an old classmate. After many introductions, you all immersed yourselves in the lively celebratory atmosphere, wandering through all kinds of stalls and tasting all sorts of food. At the Prize Redemption booth run by the Dvořák siblings, you learned that performing onstage could earn you a large number of Draw tokens. After some encouragement from Haniel, "THE WHOOTS!!!!" decided to sign up to perform.

However, before the show, Akane Rin sought you out alone and spoke about her past with Lines. She revealed that she had once buried a time capsule somewhere on campus, and had promptly planned to dig it up after the performance. The show turned out to be a great success, and as promised, Akane Rin and the crew dug up the time capsule together. Within the Anomalous Realm created by the time capsule, long-buried memories were unveiled one by one, and the full story of Lines was revealed. Elsewhere in the Anomalous Realm, Nanally and Suzuha were sent back to the day Lines encountered Swallowtail. The other members arrived just in time, and with everyone's help, they overcame their fears and united to defeat Swallowtail.

In the end, the trio—Akane Rin, Aurelia, and Suzuha—were finally able to move beyond the past, and set out once more with renewed resolve.
summary.id:
Menjelang perayaan seratus tahun Clement Academy, Akane Rin akhirnya setuju, setelah berkali-kali dibujuk Haniel dan Nanally, untuk kembali ke almamaternya sebagai alumni tamu istimewa, dengan semua orang ikut merayakan. Tapi sebelum itu, kamu harus mendapatkan seragam sekolah yang layak dulu. Saat berbelanja, Akane Rin juga mengajak teman sekelasnya dulu, Aurelia, dan memperkenalkannya kepada anggota "THE WHOOTS!!!!" yang lain.

Pada hari perayaan, rombongan tiba di kampus dan bertemu Suzuha, yang dulu satu band dengan Akane Rin di band "Lines" sekaligus teman sekelasnya. Setelah saling berkenalan, kalian larut dalam suasana perayaan yang meriah, berkeliling ke berbagai stan dan mencicipi beragam makanan. Di stan Prize Redemption yang dikelola kakak-adik Dvořák, kalian tahu bahwa tampil di panggung bisa menghasilkan banyak token Draw. Setelah disemangati Haniel, "THE WHOOTS!!!!" memutuskan mendaftar untuk tampil.

Namun, sebelum pertunjukan, Akane Rin menemuimu sendirian dan bercerita tentang masa lalunya bersama Lines. Ia mengungkapkan bahwa ia pernah mengubur kapsul waktu di suatu tempat di kampus, dan berencana menggalinya setelah pertunjukan. Pertunjukan itu sukses besar, dan sesuai janji, Akane Rin dan kawan-kawan menggali kapsul waktu itu bersama. Di dalam Anomalous Realm yang tercipta dari kapsul waktu itu, kenangan yang lama terkubur terungkap satu per satu, dan kisah lengkap Lines pun terbuka. Di bagian lain Anomalous Realm, Nanally dan Suzuha dikirim kembali ke hari saat Lines bertemu Swallowtail. Anggota lain tiba tepat waktu, dan dengan bantuan semua orang, mereka mengatasi rasa takut dan bersatu mengalahkan Swallowtail.

Pada akhirnya, ketiganya, Akane Rin, Aurelia, dan Suzuha, akhirnya bisa melangkah melewati masa lalu dan kembali berangkat dengan tekad baru.

summary.en:
You received a missing person commission from a married couple—their son Maiyue, who had a speech impediment, had gone missing after school.

After a chance encounter with Captain of ETD-4—Baicang, he joined your investigation. The clues led you to an abandoned manor that once belonged to the Serenetti family. The squad's lieutenant Skia noted that the location showed abnormal Wertheimer Index fluctuations, which the Bureau was investigating. In the manor's courtyard, you found Maiyue trapped. He was being parasitized by plants affected by Location Anomaly C-3624 "Silent Garden," and in his dazed state, he resisted rescue attempts.

Baicang used sign language to wake Maiyue from his stupor, then activated his Esper Ability. In an instant, all the plants in the manor withered as if fall had come early, and the Anomaly was successfully nullified.

Though Maiyue permanently lost his ability to speak due to the Anomaly's nullification, he was otherwise unharmed. Later, he made flower cards by hand to express his gratitude to you all. Perhaps sincere feelings need no words to be conveyed.
summary.id:
Kamu menerima komisi orang hilang dari sepasang suami istri: putra mereka, Maiyue, yang punya gangguan bicara, menghilang sepulang sekolah.

Setelah tak sengaja bertemu kapten ETD-4, Baicang, ia ikut dalam penyelidikanmu. Petunjuk membawa kalian ke sebuah rumah besar terbengkalai yang dulu milik keluarga Serenetti. Letnan regu itu, Skia, mencatat bahwa lokasi tersebut menunjukkan fluktuasi Wertheimer Index yang tidak normal, yang sedang diselidiki Bureau. Di halaman rumah, kalian menemukan Maiyue terperangkap. Ia sedang dijadikan inang oleh tanaman yang terpengaruh Location Anomaly C-3624 "Silent Garden", dan dalam keadaan linglung, ia menolak diselamatkan.

Baicang memakai bahasa isyarat untuk menyadarkan Maiyue, lalu mengaktifkan Esper Ability-nya. Dalam sekejap, semua tanaman di rumah itu layu seolah musim gugur datang lebih awal, dan Anomaly itu berhasil di-nullify.

Meski Maiyue kehilangan kemampuan bicaranya untuk selamanya akibat Nullification Anomaly tersebut, ia tidak terluka sedikit pun. Belakangan, ia membuat kartu bunga dengan tangannya sendiri untuk berterima kasih kepada kalian semua. Mungkin perasaan yang tulus memang tidak butuh kata-kata untuk tersampaikan.
